d:
"You masturbate behind my back...you deserve a punishment."

Yashima, a tanuki disguised as a Buddhist priest living among humans, and
Akari, a human, are a newlywed couple trying to conceive a child.

However, their loving newlywed life is short-lived,
as Yashima is separated from Akari for a week to begin his training as a priest...!?

Akari tries to distract herself from her loneliness with housework and work, but her feelings only grow stronger.
Yashima finds out about "that thing" she secretly bought—!?
n: [Doujinshi] My cute wife was secretly  masturbating, so I won't be satisfied until I teach her a lesson and train her!
